description.value: Chutneys Indian Grill is a fast-casual Indian restaurant chain serving fresh, modern Indian food including tandoori dishes, stuffed buns, and build-your-own bowls. The Langley location is one of three Lower Mainland branches of a BC-based franchise positioning itself as a quick, healthy alternative to typical fast food. Touring cyclists will find it a convenient stop for a filling sit-down or takeout meal along the 200 Street corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the Langley location at 6233 200 St with phone +16044270990, matching the OSM record (minor apostrophe difference in name). The site prominently features 'Order Online' and 'Pickup or Delivery' confirming takeout. No evidence on the website for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records 'Chutney's Indian Grill' (with apostrophe) but the website consistently uses 'Chutneys Indian Grill' (without apostrophe).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active fast-casual restaurant with confirmed Langley location and online ordering. Useful stopping point for touring cyclists on the 200 Street corridor.

wow_evidence: one of three Lower Mainland branches of a BC-based franchise
